program_solutions:
(rule!
  (let* ((anchor (first (find-color g 1)))
         (cells (filter (lambda (p)
                          (let ((v (at g (first p) (second p))))
                            (and (not (= v 0)) (not (= v 1)))))
                        (grid-positions g)))
         (color (at g (first (first cells)) (second (first cells))))
         (bb (bbox-of-cells cells))
         (dr (- (first anchor) (first bb)))
         (dc (- (second anchor) (second bb))))
    (for/fold ([out (empty-grid (rows g) (cols g) 0)]) ([p (in-list cells)])
      (let ((nr (+ (first p) dr)) (nc (+ (second p) dc)))
        (if (in-bounds? nr nc (rows g) (cols g))
            (set-cell out nr nc color)
            out)))))
